portal_hypertension.authors: Jeong IJ, Moon DB, Jwa EK
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PubMed 没有可用的摘要。 临床提示：无肠系膜血栓形成的门静脉高压缺血性肠病：尽管存在严重高乳酸血症，但可通过 TIPS 逆转。

portal_hypertension.title: Rifaximin ameliorates cirrhotic portal hypertension through suppression of microbiome-derived deoxycholic acid.
portal_hypertension.authors: Xiong HL, Zhao Q, Liu SQ
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：微生物组衍生的脱氧胆酸 (DCA) 会升高血清 5-羟色胺 (5-HT)，这是门脉高压 (PH) 的介质。 临床提示：利福昔明是一种不可吸收的抗生素，已知可以降低 DCA 水平。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Microbiome-derived deoxycholic acid (DCA) elevates serum 5-hydroxytryptamine (5-HT), a mediator of portal hypertension (PH). Rifaximin, a non-absorbable antibiotic, is known to reduce DCA levels. We aimed to elucidate the role of DCA in cirrhotic PH and the therapeutic potential of rifaximin. PH was induced in mice by thioacetamide (TAA) injection or bile duct ligation (BDL). Mice were treated with antibiotics (ABX) or rifaximin, with or without exogenous DCA replenishment. A cohort of 51 cirrhotic patients and 19 healthy controls was analyzed to validate the correlations among DCA, 5-HT, and hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG).
